mapper.select: SELECT a.province, a.subject_type, a.year, a.min_score, a.min_rank, m.id AS major_id, m.name AS major_name, m.category, m.description FROM admission a JOIN major m ON m.id = a.major_id AND m.school_id = a.school_id WHERE a.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY a.year DESC, a.subject_type, m.name
